name: Kelic Caelen
keeps: the arithmetic nobody else wants to do
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
reason: The word alchemy carries an Arabic article on the front of it because of this tradition.
text: Kelic caelen of the borrowed hour, keeps the book for the 5th tranche, doors 39 to 47. Keeps the arithmetic nobody else wants to do. Reads Jabir ibn Hayyan (Geber).
